about.title: About Online Stopwatch - Precision Timing & Lap Timer
about.description: The Online Stopwatch is a precise digital timer that measures elapsed time from start to stop with millisecond accuracy. Perfect for sports timing, productivity tracking, cooking, workouts, or any activity requiring accurate time measurement. Features lap timing, split times, and can run continuously in the background. The stopwatch maintains accuracy even when switching between browser tabs or applications, making it ideal for professional timing needs.

howTo.title: How to Use the Online Stopwatch

steps.title: Start Timing
steps.description: Click the start button to begin precise time measurement with millisecond accuracy.

steps.title: Record Lap Times
steps.description: Use the lap button to record split times without stopping the main timer.

steps.title: Stop Timer
steps.description: Click stop to pause the timer while maintaining the current elapsed time.

steps.title: Reset Stopwatch
steps.description: Use reset to clear all times and return to zero for a fresh timing session.

steps.title: View Results
steps.description: Review lap times, split times, and total elapsed time in the results display.

steps.title: Continue Timing
steps.description: Resume timing from where you stopped or start a new session as needed.

faq.q: How accurate is the online stopwatch?
faq.a: The stopwatch is accurate to milliseconds and uses high-precision browser timing APIs for reliable measurements. It maintains accuracy comparable to professional timing equipment for most applications.

faq.q: Can I record multiple lap times during timing?
faq.a: Yes, you can record unlimited lap times during a timing session. Each lap shows both the split time (time for that specific lap) and cumulative time (total time elapsed), perfect for interval training or race timing.

faq.q: Does the stopwatch work in background tabs?
faq.a: Yes, the stopwatch continues running accurately even when you switch to other browser tabs or minimize the window. The precision timing continues uninterrupted in the background.

faq.q: What happens if I accidentally close the browser?
faq.a: The timing data will be lost if you close the browser completely. For important timing sessions, keep the tab open or regularly record lap times to capture intermediate measurements before any potential interruption.
